# IGFCSS FEFSS 2024 annual report

The Instituto de Gestão de Fundos de Capitalização da Segurança Social
(IGFCSS) publishes annual financial information for the **Fundo de
Estabilização Financeira da Segurança Social (FEFSS)**.

- Source: [Relatório Anual 2024](https://www.seg-social.pt/storage1/files/RC-FEFSS-2024---RAs-VDHtTs2KSjWxovXmLCEDiA.pdf).
- Board approval date printed in the report: 25 March 2025.
- Research retrieval date: 30 October 2026.
- PDF size: 4,185,914 bytes.
- SHA-256 from the downstream manifest:
  `088be0de82e2e0c9fea5f1629b07b2b91d7a8c260b41f83edfd3903ce0ef6770`.

The downstream `data/sources/igfcss_fefss_reports.json` identifies:

| Published table | Location | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Table 1 | PDF p. 11 (printed p. 10) | FEFSS year-end and average assets, fund transfers, investment returns and risk metrics, 2019–2024 |
| Table 3 | PDF p. 22 (printed p. 21) | Transfers received: combined 1989–2004 period and annual rows for 2005–2024 |

At year-end 2024 the fund reported **€35,878,507,552** of assets, against
**€24,241,760,210** in cumulative transfers and **€11,636,747,342** of
value added since inception (rounded to whole euros). These three measures
must not be summed or mislabelled as new government expenditure.

The report describes a **fund asset stock** and investment performance. It
does not provide evidence that its entire portfolio is a cash surplus
available to build housing. An allocation proposal needs separate legal and
budgetary treatment.
